relations.label: shes rab grags pa (4105) author of lam gyi rim pa (5882)
relations.zotero_refs:
Author of No. 18928 according to [8H6M69W4]: dge bshes shes rab grags pa. However, the identification of the instance (ID:5881) with No. 18928 is uncertain.
The editors of [5DSBYG9K] identify the author as "shes rab grags pa" based on the colophon verses referring to the bla ma's name with the Sanskrit for "ye shes byang chub" ([5DSBYG9K]: 335).
[NTGHCZA8]: 42, n. 88 suggests the author could be Chu mig pa Shes rab grags (ID:3975).

comments:
BUDA identifies him with the 14th-c. scholar by that name (https://purl.bdrc.io/resource/P5907), but the editors of [5DSBYG9K] suggest that the author of the Lam rim work he was a student of Lum pa ba Ye shes byang chub living in the 12th century ([5DSBYG9K]: 335).
Possibly the same person as Chu mig pa Shes rab grags (ID:3795) ([NTGHCZA8]: 42, n. 88).
